_design_note: The opponent-shaping arm, at n=3 rather than n=5, and the reason is not a preference. Potential-based shaping contributes gamma^n * phi(s_t+n) - phi(s_t) to an n-step target -- the telescoping that gives policy invariance. A bomb's observable life is exactly BOMB_TIMER+1 = 5 transitions, so with n_step=5 the window around a bomb drop starts before the bomb exists and ends after it is gone, both endpoints carry delta-phi = 0, and the new term contributes EXACTLY zero to the target of the very decision it was written to shape. Measured, not argued: the per-state delta-phi is [0, .3, .3, .3, .3, 0], the per-step A07-A06 shaping is [+.285, -.015, -.015, -.015, -.300], and the n=5 target difference is -0.000000. The contribution is +0.257 at n=3, +0.244 at n=4 and 0.000 at every n >= 5. Section 7.27.1 measured n=3 as indistinguishable from n=5 (+0.63 against a 2.85 gap), so moving off the resonance costs nothing measurable. Motivation for the term itself is unchanged: diagnose_kill_opportunities.py found F2 standing 9,930 times where a bomb would have caught an opponent, able to escape after dropping in 97.9 percent of them, and dropping in 8.0 percent; on rule_based_agent's adjacency trigger, 218 of 3,299. And 820 KILLED_OPPONENT against 156,870 COIN_COLLECTED is why it cannot fix itself.

_predeclared_design_numbers.activation_rate_is_a_precondition_not_a_: n=3 removes the structural cancellation that made the term contribute exactly zero at n=5. It does not guarantee a signal: the contribution is gamma^3 * delta-phi(s_t+3), so if the opponent has left every blast by t+3 the target difference is again exactly zero, now because the opponent moved rather than because of the resonance. The diagnostic reports how often the potential is still raised at ticks 1-4 after a qualifying drop; a low rate at tick 3 means a null result from this arm is uninterpretable, and that has to be known BEFORE the arm is read.
_predeclared_design_numbers.changed_factor: reward_version A06 -> A07 (shaping potential_v1 -> potential_v2). The event table and death penalty are identical, and n_step and the budget match the control exactly, so the new term is the only variable.
_predeclared_design_numbers.control: runs/m3_n3_2500_vs3rb_20260827/ -- A06, n=3, 2500 rounds, three opponents. This is the ONLY causal control: it differs from this arm in reward_version alone. F2 is n=5 and 5000 rounds and cannot carry a single-factor claim about the new term.
_predeclared_design_numbers.falsification: Take-up unchanged means the shaping term does not reach the decision and the kill gap is not closable this way; record the negative result and stop.
_predeclared_design_numbers.mechanism_baseline_must_be_remeasured: The 8.0 percent take-up and 6.6 percent adjacency figures were measured on F2. They are the historical motivation, NOT this arm's baseline. Run diagnose_kill_opportunities.py on runs/m3_n3_2500_vs3rb_20260827/ first and compare against its own numbers.
_predeclared_design_numbers.n3_versus_n5_wording: Section 7.27.1 found no detectable difference between n=3 and n=5 at this power (+0.63 against a 2.85 gap). That is 'no cost detected', not 'zero cost'; a real difference could sit under the threshold. Do not write 'costs nothing'.
_predeclared_design_numbers.prediction: None stated. Five mechanism hypotheses were overturned by measurement this round.
_predeclared_design_numbers.reporting: All five training-seed distributions, coins_share, kills, the death split, the take-up numbers, and the ten repeat measurements individually.
_predeclared_design_numbers.resolution_loot_crate: This suite is loot-crate WITH opponents; its control's cross-seed sd gives a 95% resolvable gap of about 2.85, not the 4.7 derived from the solo control (section 7.27.1).
_predeclared_design_numbers.resolution_tournament: Ten repeats of classic_versus_opponents, as section 7.26.3 required. To claim the term works, the n=3 A06 control has to be repeat-measured too; F2's ten repeats do not serve for that.
_predeclared_design_numbers.the_cost_to_watch: F2 loses 42.1 percent of its deaths to opponents against M3.4's 34.0. Report the death split and survival for this arm against the n=3 control's, and treat a score gain bought with a survival collapse the way section 7.25.3 treated M3.13's.
_predeclared_design_numbers.the_metric_that_decides_it: Re-run diagnose_kill_opportunities.py. The number that has to move is the 8.0 percent take-up of blast-covering positions, and the 6.6 percent on rule_based's adjacency trigger. Tournament score moving without those moving would not be this term working.
_predeclared_design_numbers.two_comparisons_kept_separate: 1. Causal: A07 vs A06 at n=3/2500, both suites, and the take-up numbers from the same pair. 2. Model selection: A07 vs F2, which may decide what is submitted but cannot attribute the difference to the shaping term, because n_step and budget differ too.
_predeclared_design_numbers.why_it_cannot_corrupt_the_objective: potential-based shaping is policy-invariant (Ng, Harada & Russell 1999). If declining the bomb is genuinely optimal, A07 cannot teach otherwise; it can only speed up learning the 5.0 that KILLED_OPPONENT already carries.
_predeclared_design_numbers.why_not_n5: At n_step=5 the term contributes exactly zero to the bomb-drop target, because a bomb lives exactly 5 transitions and potential shaping telescopes over the window. Running it at n=5 would test a mechanism the arm cannot deliver.
